title: Syncqra: Cloud Sync & Backup
summary: Sync your local folders  across Google Drive, OneDrive, Dropbox, Box, and more
description:
SyncQra is a file synchronization and backup utility that automatically synchronizes folders anywhere on your device with cloud storage providers and remote destinations. Users can select any folder on shared storage, including nested directories and folders created by other applications. SyncQra continuously monitors changes and synchronizes documents, media, archives, databases, source code, and other file types while preserving complete folder structures.

Key Features
• Synchronize any folder on shared storage
• Automatic background synchronization
• Continuous file and folder monitoring
• Support for documents, media, archives, databases, source code, and other file types
• Preserve complete directory structures
• Multi-cloud synchronization
• Backup and restore folder hierarchies
• User-controlled synchronization destinations
